zh.title: Windows 安装包运行时架构修正
highlights: 修复 v3.33.0 Windows 包装入 macOS 运行时（并发构建竞争）导致的启动失败；产品代码与 v3.33.0 一致。
构建脚本加并发互斥锁，杜绝同类竞争。
zh.notice: Windows 用户请直接安装 v3.33.1（v3.33.0 的 Windows 包不可用）。

en.title: Windows installer runtime-architecture fix
highlights: Fixes v3.33.0 Windows packages shipping macOS runtimes due to a concurrent-build race; product code is identical to v3.33.0.
Build scripts now take a mutual-exclusion lock to prevent the race.
en.notice: Windows users: install v3.33.1 directly (the v3.33.0 Windows package does not start).
